unique_approach.name: The 3 Touch Method
unique_approach.summary: You only handle the dough three times. Everything else is waiting.
unique_approach.visual: A timeline with three hand icons on it and long quiet gaps between them.
unique_approach.rationale: Beginners overwork dough. Fewer touches means fewer ways to get it wrong.
